# framqaqc

The goal of framqaqc is to streamline the QAQC process for FRAM
development.

## Installation

You can install the development version of framqaqc from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("FRAMverse/framqaqc")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`compare_databases()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/compare_databases.md)
  :

  **\[experimental\]** Compare tables in two equivalent FRAM databases

- [`compare_table_across_dbs()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/compare_table_across_dbs.md)
  : Compare tables between two databases

- [`plot_comparisons_exact()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/plot_comparisons_exact.md)
  : Plot the values of the two databases against each other

- [`plot_comparisons_ratio()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/plot_comparisons_ratio.md)
  : Plot the ratios of database comparisons

- [`run_info()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/run_info.md)
  : Provides a print out of Run ID information

- [`summarize_exact()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/summarize_exact.md)
  :

  Summarize exact differences from
  [`compare_table_across_dbs()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/compare_table_across_dbs.md)

- [`summarize_ratio()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/summarize_ratio.md)
  :

  Summarize ratio differences from
  [`compare_table_across_dbs()`](https://framverse.github.io/framqaqc/reference/compare_table_across_dbs.md)
